AltScreenMode.description:
Controls whether the TUI uses the terminal's alternate screen buffer.

**Background:** The alternate screen buffer provides a cleaner fullscreen experience without polluting the terminal's scrollback history. However, it conflicts with terminal multiplexers like Zellij that strictly follow the xterm specification, which defines that alternate screen buffers should not have scrollback.

**Zellij's behavior:** Zellij intentionally disables scrollback in alternate screen mode (see https://github.com/zellij-org/zellij/pull/1032) to comply with the xterm spec. This is by design and not configurable in Zellij—there is no option to enable scrollback in alternate screen mode.

**Solution:** This setting provides a pragmatic workaround: - `auto` (default): Automatically detect the terminal multiplexer. If running in Zellij, disable alternate screen to preserve scrollback. Enable it everywhere else. - `always`: Always use alternate screen mode (original behavior before this fix). - `never`: Never use alternate screen mode. Runs in inline mode, preserving scrollback in all multiplexers.

The CLI flag `--no-alt-screen` can override this setting at runtime.

oneOf.description: Auto-detect: disable alternate screen in Zellij, enable elsewhere.

oneOf.description: Under this policy, only "known safe" commands—as determined by `is_safe_command()`—that **only read files** are auto‑approved. Everything else will ask the user to approve.

DEPRECATED: *All* commands are auto‑approved, but they are expected to run inside a sandbox where network access is disabled and writes are confined to a specific set of paths. If the command fails, it will be escalated to the user to approve execution without a sandbox. Prefer `OnRequest` for interactive runs or `Never` for non-interactive runs.

collaboration_modes.description: Enable collaboration modes (Plan, Default). Kept for config backward compatibility; behavior is always collaboration-modes-enabled. Status: removed and retained for backward compatibility. Enabled by default.

connectors.description: Deprecated alias for `[features].apps`. Enable apps. Use a connected ChatGPT App using "$". Install Apps via /apps command. Restart Codex after enabling. Status: experimental. Disabled by default.

default_mode_request_user_input.description: Allow request_user_input in Default collaboration mode. Status: under development. Disabled by default.

elevated_windows_sandbox.description: Use the elevated Windows sandbox pipeline (setup + runner). Status: removed and retained for backward compatibility. Disabled by default.

enable_experimental_windows_sandbox.description: Deprecated alias for `[features].experimental_windows_sandbox`. Enable Windows sandbox (restricted token) on Windows. Status: removed and retained for backward compatibility. Disabled by default.

enable_fanout.description: Enable CSV-backed agent job tools. Status: under development. Disabled by default.

enable_request_compression.description: Compress request bodies (zstd) when sending streaming requests to codex-backend. Status: stable. Enabled by default.

exec_permission_approvals.description: Allow exec tools to request additional permissions while staying sandboxed. Status: under development. Disabled by default.

experimental_use_freeform_apply_patch.description: Deprecated alias for `[features].apply_patch_freeform`. Include the freeform apply_patch tool. Status: under development. Disabled by default.

experimental_use_unified_exec_tool.description: Deprecated alias for `[features].unified_exec`. Use the single unified PTY-backed exec tool. Status: stable. Enabled by default on non-Windows platforms and disabled by default on Windows.

experimental_windows_sandbox.description: Enable Windows sandbox (restricted token) on Windows. Status: removed and retained for backward compatibility. Disabled by default.

fast_mode.description: Enable Fast mode selection in the TUI and request layer. Status: stable. Enabled by default.

guardian_approval.description: Enable automatic review for approval prompts. When Codex needs approval for higher-risk actions (e.g. sandbox escapes or blocked network access), route eligible approval requests to a carefully-prompted security reviewer subagent rather than blocking the agent on your input. This can consume significantly more tokens because it runs a subagent on every approval request. Status: experimental. Disabled by default.

image_detail_original.description: Allow the model to request `detail: "original"` image outputs on supported models. Status: under development. Disabled by default.

image_generation.description: Allow the model to invoke the built-in image generation tool. Status: under development. Disabled by default.

include_apply_patch_tool.description: Deprecated alias for `[features].apply_patch_freeform`. Include the freeform apply_patch tool. Status: under development. Disabled by default.

js_repl.description: Enable JavaScript REPL tools backed by a persistent Node kernel. Enable a persistent Node-backed JavaScript REPL for interactive website debugging and other inline JavaScript execution capabilities. Requires Node >= v22.22.0 installed. Status: experimental. Disabled by default.

js_repl_tools_only.description: Only expose js_repl tools directly to the model. Status: under development. Disabled by default.

memories.description: Enable startup memory extraction and file-backed memory consolidation. Status: under development. Disabled by default.

memory_tool.description: Deprecated alias for `[features].memories`. Enable startup memory extraction and file-backed memory consolidation. Status: under development. Disabled by default.

multi_agent.description: Enable collab tools. Status: stable. Enabled by default.

multi_agent_v2.description: Enable task-path-based multi-agent routing. Status: under development. Disabled by default.

personality.description: Enable personality selection in the TUI. Status: stable. Enabled by default.

plugins.description: Enable plugins. Status: under development. Disabled by default.

prevent_idle_sleep.description: Prevent idle system sleep while a turn is actively running. Keep your computer awake while Codex is running a thread. Status: experimental. Disabled by default.

realtime_conversation.description: Enable experimental realtime voice conversation mode in the TUI. Status: under development. Disabled by default.

remote_models.description: Legacy remote models flag kept for backward compatibility. Status: removed and retained for backward compatibility. Disabled by default.

request_permissions.description: Deprecated alias for `[features].exec_permission_approvals`. Allow exec tools to request additional permissions while staying sandboxed. Status: under development. Disabled by default.

request_permissions_tool.description: Expose the built-in request_permissions tool. Status: under development. Disabled by default.

request_rule.description: Allow the model to request approval and propose exec rules. Status: removed and retained for backward compatibility. Disabled by default.

responses_websockets.description: Legacy rollout flag for Responses API WebSocket transport experiments. Status: removed and retained for backward compatibility. Disabled by default.

responses_websockets_v2.description: Legacy rollout flag for Responses API WebSocket transport v2 experiments. Status: removed and retained for backward compatibility. Disabled by default.

runtime_metrics.description: Enable runtime metrics snapshots via a manual reader. Status: under development. Disabled by default.

search_tool.description: Legacy search-tool feature flag kept for backward compatibility. Status: removed and retained for backward compatibility. Disabled by default.

shell_snapshot.description: Experimental shell snapshotting. Status: stable. Enabled by default.

shell_tool.description: Enable the default shell tool. Status: stable. Enabled by default.

shell_zsh_fork.description: Route shell tool execution through the zsh exec bridge. Status: under development. Disabled by default.

skill_env_var_dependency_prompt.description: Prompt for missing skill env var dependencies. Status: under development. Disabled by default.

skill_mcp_dependency_install.description: Allow prompting and installing missing MCP dependencies. Status: stable. Enabled by default.

sqlite.description: Persist rollout metadata to a local SQLite database. Status: removed and retained for backward compatibility. Enabled by default.

steer.description: Steer feature flag - when enabled, Enter submits immediately instead of queuing. Kept for config backward compatibility; behavior is always steer-enabled. Status: removed and retained for backward compatibility. Enabled by default.

tool_call_mcp_elicitation.description: Route MCP tool approval prompts through the MCP elicitation request path. Status: under development. Disabled by default.

tool_suggest.description: Enable discoverable tool suggestions for apps. Status: under development. Disabled by default.

tui_app_server.description: Route interactive startup to the app-server-backed TUI implementation. Use the app-server-backed TUI implementation. Status: experimental. Disabled by default.

undo.description: Create a ghost commit at each turn. Status: stable. Disabled by default.

unified_exec.description: Use the single unified PTY-backed exec tool. Status: stable. Enabled by default on non-Windows platforms and disabled by default on Windows.

use_legacy_landlock.description: Use the legacy Landlock Linux sandbox fallback instead of the default bubblewrap pipeline. Status: stable. Disabled by default.

use_linux_sandbox_bwrap.description: Removed legacy Linux bubblewrap opt-in flag retained as a no-op so old wrappers and config can still parse it. Status: removed and retained for backward compatibility. Disabled by default.

voice_transcription.description: Enable voice transcription in the TUI composer. Status: under development. Disabled by default.

web_search.description: Deprecated alias for `[features].web_search_request`. Allow the model to request web searches that fetch live content. Status: deprecated. Disabled by default.

web_search_cached.description: Allow the model to request web searches that fetch cached content. Takes precedence over `WebSearchRequest`. Status: deprecated. Disabled by default.

web_search_request.description: Allow the model to request web searches that fetch live content. Status: deprecated. Disabled by default.

feedback.description: When `false`, disables feedback collection across Codex product surfaces. Defaults to `true`.

file_opener.description: Optional URI-based file opener. If set, citations to files in the model output will be hyperlinked using the specified URI scheme.

oneOf.description: Option to disable the URI-based file opener.

forced_chatgpt_workspace_id.description: When set, restricts ChatGPT login to a specific workspace identifier.

forced_login_method.description: When set, restricts the login mechanism users may use.

ghost_snapshot.description: Settings for ghost snapshots (used for undo).

hide_agent_reasoning.description: When set to `true`, `AgentReasoning` events will be hidden from the UI/output. Defaults to `false`.

history.description: Settings that govern if and what will be written to `~/.codex/history.jsonl`.

js_repl_node_module_dirs.description: Ordered list of directories to search for Node modules in `js_repl`.

js_repl_node_path.description: Optional absolute path to the Node runtime used by `js_repl`.

log_dir.description: Directory where Codex writes log files, for example `codex-tui.log`. Defaults to `$CODEX_HOME/log`.

mcp_oauth_callback_port.description: Optional fixed port for the local HTTP callback server used during MCP OAuth login. When unset, Codex will bind to an ephemeral port chosen by the OS.

mcp_oauth_callback_url.description: Optional redirect URI to use during MCP OAuth login. When set, this URI is used in the OAuth authorization request instead of the local listener address. The local callback listener still binds to 127.0.0.1 (using `mcp_oauth_callback_port` when provided).

mcp_oauth_credentials_store.description: Preferred backend for storing MCP OAuth credentials. keyring: Use an OS-specific keyring service. https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/main/codex-rs/rmcp-client/src/oauth.rs#L2 file: Use a file in the Codex home directory. auto (default): Use the OS-specific keyring service if available, otherwise use a file.

oneOf.description: `Keyring` when available; otherwise, `File`. Credentials stored in the keyring will only be readable by Codex unless the user explicitly grants access via OS-level keyring access.
CODEX_HOME/.credentials.json This file will be readable to Codex and other applications running as the same user.
Keyring when available, otherwise fail.

mcp_servers.description: Definition for MCP servers that Codex can reach out to for tool calls.

oneOf.description: Bundled model slugs from `core/models.json`.
Any other model slug from a custom model catalog or provider.

model_auto_compact_token_limit.description: Token usage threshold triggering auto-compaction of conversation history.

model_catalog_json.description: Optional path to a JSON model catalog (applied on startup only). Per-thread `config` overrides are accepted but do not reapply this (no-ops).

model_context_window.description: Size of the context window for the model, in tokens.

model_instructions_file.description: Optional path to a file containing model instructions that will override the built-in instructions for the selected model. Users are STRONGLY DISCOURAGED from using this field, as deviating from the instructions sanctioned by Codex will likely degrade model performance.

model_provider.description: Provider to use from the model_providers map.

model_providers.description: User-defined provider entries that extend the built-in list. Built-in IDs cannot be overridden.

model_reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort to request from the primary model when supported.

model_reasoning_summary.description: Reasoning summary detail level to request when supported by the model.

oneOf.description: Option to disable reasoning summaries.

model_supports_reasoning_summaries.description: Override to force-enable reasoning summaries for the configured model.

model_verbosity.description: Optional verbosity control for GPT-5 models (Responses API `text.verbosity`).

notice.description: Collection of in-product notices (different from notifications) See [`crate::config::types::Notices`] for more details

notify.description: Optional external command to spawn for end-user notifications.

openai_base_url.description: Base URL override for the built-in `openai` model provider.

oss_provider.description: Preferred OSS provider for local models, e.g. "lmstudio" or "ollama".

personality.description: Optionally specify a personality for the model

plan_mode_reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort override to use when starting Plan mode sessions.

plugins.description: User-level plugin config entries keyed by plugin name.

profile.description: Profile to use from the `profiles` map.

profiles.description: Named profiles to facilitate switching between different configurations.

project_doc_fallback_filenames.description: Ordered list of fallback filenames to look for when AGENTS.md is missing.

project_doc_max_bytes.description: Maximum number of bytes to include from an AGENTS.md project doc file.

project_root_markers.description: Markers used to detect the project root when searching parent directories for `.codex` folders. Defaults to [".git"] when unset.

projects.description: Per-project trust settings keyed by project root path.

realtime.description: Experimental / do not use. Realtime websocket session selection. `version` controls v1/v2 and `type` controls conversational/transcription.

review_model.description: Review model override used by the `/review` feature.

oneOf.description: Bundled model slugs from `core/models.json`.
Any other model slug from a custom model catalog or provider.

sandbox_workspace_write.description: Sandbox configuration to apply if `sandbox` is `WorkspaceWrite`.

service_tier.description: Optional explicit service tier preference for new turns (`fast` or `flex`).

shell_environment_policy.description: Policy used to build process environments for shell/unified exec.

show_raw_agent_reasoning.description: When set to `true`, `AgentReasoningRawContentEvent` events will be shown in the UI/output. Defaults to `false`.

skills.description: User-level skill config entries keyed by SKILL.md path.

sqlite_home.description: Directory where Codex stores the SQLite state DB. Defaults to `$CODEX_SQLITE_HOME` when set. Otherwise uses `$CODEX_HOME`.

suppress_unstable_features_warning.description: Suppress warnings about unstable (under development) features.

tool_output_token_limit.description: Token budget applied when storing tool/function outputs in the context manager.

tool_suggest.description: Additional discoverable tools that can be suggested for installation.

tools.description: Nested tools section for feature toggles

tui.description: Collection of settings that are specific to the TUI.

web_search.description: Controls the web search tool mode: disabled, cached, or live.

windows_wsl_setup_acknowledged.description: Tracks whether the Windows onboarding screen has been acknowledged.

zsh_path.description: Optional absolute path to patched zsh used by zsh-exec-bridge-backed shell execution.
